clean_repro.probe: POST /entities/insert with fields '123field' and '@field' → succeeds (200). POST /entities/query with outputFields=['123field','@field'] → fails with 'parse output field name failed: 123field'
clean_repro.observed: Insert accepts invalid field names (starting with digit, starting with special char). Query rejects same field names in outputFields parameter with parse error.
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl -X POST http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/entities/insert -d '{"collectionName":"test_dev_review_005","data":[{"id":1,"vector":[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4],"123field":"v1"},{"id":2,"vector":[0.2,0.2,0.3,0.4],"@field":"v2"}]}' → 200 OK. curl -X POST http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/entities/query -d '{"collectionName":"test_dev_review_005","filter":"id in [1,2]","outputFields":["123field","@field"]}' → 65535 error.

contract_refs: No explicit constraint in structured_contract.json regarding field name validation for insert vs query asymmetry

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: Insert → utils.go parseInsertData → accepts any JSON keys without validation. Query → util.go parseOutputFields → validates field names via isAlpha/isNumber checks → rejects '123field' (starts with digit) and '@field' (starts with special char)
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:insert 路径(utils.go parseInsertData)对 dynamic field 名不做任何校验,直接接受 JSON key;query 路径(util.go parseOutputFields)对 field 名做严格校验(必须字母开头或下划线),导致两者不对称接受同一字段名

falsification.probe: POST /entities/get with id=[1,2] and outputFields=['*'] → returns actual stored data showing '123field' and '@field' were successfully inserted and stored
falsification.observed: Entities were successfully stored with invalid field names. GET /entities/get returns: [{"123field":"v1","id":1,...},{"@field":"v2","id":2,...}]. This proves insert accepted the invalid names, contradicting query's rejection.

cognition_match.note: 未命中 developer_cognition.json 中的已知模式,属于发现的非对称验证新缺陷

verdicts.rationale: Insert 和 query 对同一字段名采用不对称验证规则:insert 接受任意 JSON key(包括以数字开头如 '123field'、以特殊字符开头如 '@field'),query 在 parseOutputFields 中拒绝不符合命名规范的字段(必须字母或下划线开头)。这导致数据能插入但无法查询,形成数据写入后不可访问的实质性缺陷。源码接地确认:insert 路径无校验,query 路径有 isAlpha/isNumber 校验。Falsification 通过 GET 证伪:数据确实存储成功。
